name: Santhiya
tagline: Every frame of my life is better with you in it.

page.passHint: Hint: the day we became us (DDMM) ♥
opening: I know this isn't an ordinary gift…
but I made every little piece of it, just for you.
page.fromMeSub: This is how much I love you

gift.title: Your gift is on the way ♥
gift.name: Rose-gold Nebula watch
gift.text: A rose-gold watch with a mother-of-pearl dial, so every second of your day reminds you of me. It's already travelling to you.

places.name: Home
places.caption: Where everything feels safe
places.text: Home isn't just a place. It's the smile you carry into every room. Even your shark friend agrees you're the best part of it.

places.name: Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts and Science
places.caption: Where you grew into you
places.text: Lectures, friends, canteen chai and big dreams. Every corridor here has heard you laugh.

places.name: Bangalore PG
places.caption: A small room in a big city
places.text: Far from home, you turned one small room in Bangalore into a whole world. Late-night talks, selfies, big dreams, all in one little corner of the city.

places.name: Our Café
places.caption: Two cups, one table
places.text: Two cups, one table, and hours that felt like minutes. If I could relive a single afternoon, it would start here with you across from me.

places.name: Our Museum
places.caption: A museum built out of your photos
places.text: Walk through every moment I keep close.

places.name: The Little Stage
places.caption: Where you first shone
places.text: Long before I knew you, you were already shining. I wish I could have clapped from the front row.

places.name: Movie Nights
places.caption: Now showing: us
places.text: We've watched so many stories together, but ours is still my favourite one playing.

places.name: Puzzle House
places.caption: Solve both puzzles for a surprise
places.text: Two little puzzles made of our photos. Finish both and something special is waiting.

places.name: Sunset Park
places.caption: Golden light, quiet bench
places.text: Golden light, a quiet bench, and you. This is where I'd stop time.

places.name: Love Letters
places.caption: A letter, just for you
places.text: Every heart you collected is a little piece of how I feel. Here's the letter I wrote you.

letter: If I could rewind my life like a film and choose the best scene, I wouldn't pick a grand moment. I'd pick any quiet one where you're beside me, laughing at something small.
You turned ordinary days into my favourite memories. You make me braver, softer, and happier than I knew I could be.
Thank you for being my home, my calm, and my greatest adventure. I love you more than words, and I'll spend a lifetime showing you.
